alt: Modern Love, collage: long dark hair over a black sweatshirt lettered LOVE, with cut-out headlines, a red label and small photos.
description: Almost all black: the back of a head of long dark-brown hair falls over a black sweatshirt printed with white gothic lettering, LOVE, at lower right. Down the left side are a black-and-white photo of a couple kissing in a tiled shower with its printed caption, a red shipping label, two cut-out headlines, a black-and-white photo of two men raising their middle fingers, an eye-in-triangle emblem and a black hand on torn paper; two instant-photo close-ups of underwear sit in the top-right and bottom-right corners. The quiet area is the black between them on the right; mind the middle fingers, the underwear and the fashion brand name before showing it large or cropping a detail.
words: Klaas Zwijnenburg: Detail from Zomer 96, 1996, photograph, 23½ inches square; at MK Expositieruimte.
qualityNote: Sharp scan, fine to 2400. A thin pale-blue strip shows along the bottom-left edge of the sheet.

alt: Reflections of Me, collage: a woman seen from behind in a black dress with a white snake, flanked by wavy paper silhouettes.
description: A woman seen from behind, in a black sleeveless dress with a white beaded snake down the back and gold cuffs, stands at centre top; her outline repeats to left and right as wavy silhouettes cut from pink satin, grass, grey sea, a beach and dark paper. Below her a pale mint arch holds a second woman with long blonde hair looking straight out, cut off by the bottom edge. The border all round is a wall of small pinned sepia portrait photos; the piece is full-bleed with no blank margin, and the calmest area is the mint arch.

alt: Royal Love Story, collage: a man and a woman cheek to cheek under a giant diamond bottle, a gilded opera house and a red heart.
description: A man and a woman in black pose cheek to cheek at lower right; a huge cut-diamond perfume bottle with a gold crown covers the man's eyes. Behind them are a gilded opera house with a chandelier, a torn black strip of gold script, an anatomical red heart in the top-left corner, red marbling down the left side and a tiny figure in a red uniform at bottom left. Busy from edge to edge with no empty space, in warm dim light.
qualityNote: Low resolution: only exists 459 px wide, soft, with visible compression. Never show it wider than 459 px; shop card and product page only.

alt: Senor Tigre, collage: a laughing woman in a white swimsuit on a jungle veranda pets a tiger; more tigers prowl along the bottom.
description: A laughing woman in a white swimsuit sits in a woven chair on a green-framed veranda above a jungle valley, her hand on a large tiger that sniffs an open notebook on a tree-stump table. A straw hat and a striped towel hang on the post at left, and a row of cut-out tigers on black strips prowls across the bottom, with two more at lower left. Sunny, warm afternoon light; the open space is the sky and treetops through the windows in the top half, and the right edge is a torn white paper edge.
qualityNote: Sharp scan, fine to 2400. The white torn edge down the right side is part of the sheet.

alt: Small World, collage: black-and-white women, one shouldering a rake, beside hand-painted blue words KEEP YOUR EYES TO THE SKY.
description: Mostly black, white and blue. A black-and-white woman in a white shirt-dress and boots carries a rake over her shoulder at left; at lower right a black-and-white woman in a dark jacket holds a hat on a cobbled street. Hand-painted cobalt-blue capitals fill the upper right, with pale-blue paper strips above and a fan of them below, and scraps of magazine text at top left; the white paper at upper left is the only empty area.
words: KEEP YOUR EYES TO THE SKY
qualityNote: Low resolution: only exists 480 px wide (source 846 px) and slightly soft. Card size only, never wider than 480 px.

alt: Society, collage: wave-cut bands of snowy mountains, a city skyline and a snow-covered town, dotted with small cut-out people.
description: Wave-cut bands stack from top to bottom: clear blue sky, mountains with a castle, a mountain biker and a mansion, a snowy forested slope, a warm-toned city skyline with a man lounging in an armchair, then a snow-covered town and rooftops. Small groups of cut-out people line the lower third: a long-haired group at left, riders in cowboy hats, three people behind a hand-lettered sign, a family holding hands. Bright cold daylight; the empty space is the sky across the top, and a strip of white torn paper runs down the upper right edge.
qualityNote: Sharp scan, fine to 2400. The horizontal bands survive a wide crop well.

alt: Stuck, collage: a woman at a night festival, fireworks, grey loudspeakers and a man meditating on sheet music, on white paper.
description: On white paper with a clear margin all round. At top left a woman in sunglasses and a chain top poses against a railing at night, with fireworks on black at top right; a strip of handwriting crosses the middle. Below it grey-blue loudspeakers stand behind a man in a cap and brown shirt who sits cross-legged with his eyes closed on strips of aged sheet music; the white margin is widest in the bottom corners either side of him.
words: you are the song stuck in my mind ...
qualityNote: Sharp scan, fine to 2400. The white paper margin is part of the file and will show against an off-white page.

alt: Tears Water The Soul - Green, collage: a woman's face under a green embroidered mask and headdress, with iridescent paper tears.
description: Square. A woman in a tweed jacket with a heavy jewelled necklace and earrings faces the viewer; her upper face is covered by a mask and tall headdress built from green embroidery, a leafy tree, deep-blue brushwork and gold star and moon brooches, with her eyes showing through. Iridescent pink-and-blue paper teardrops fall from the eyes and spray out to both sides. White ground with empty space in both top corners and at mid left and right; a signature in green marker sits bottom left and a small stray brown strip top right.
qualityNote: Largest file is 1600 px and a little soft at full size; a thin grey line shows along the bottom edge. Best kept to about 1000 px wide or less.

alt: Tears Water The Soul - Pink, collage: a woman in a pink dress under a headdress of flowers and pink jewels, gem tears on her cheeks.
description: A red-haired woman in an off-the-shoulder pink dress raises one hand to her face; her eyes look out through a mask of pink petals, and gemstone tears in red and purple hang on her cheeks. A tall headdress of mixed flowers, a large pink faceted gem, a pink jewelled brooch and a small bird fills the top half. Plain white ground with empty space down both sides of the figure, in soft bright light.
qualityNote: Low resolution (source 988 px wide) and soft, like a photo of a print. Largest file is 960; keep it at card size, about 600 px wide or less.

alt: Tears Water The Soul - Silver, collage: a bare-shouldered woman under a silver crown piled with watches, gold coins, rings and cars.
description: A dark-haired, bare-shouldered woman faces the viewer head-on wearing a jewelled pendant; a chrome crown of metal flowers and diamond brooches sits low over her brow so only her eyes show, with one small grey diamond-shaped paper tear on her cheek. Piled on the crown are two wristwatches, two gold coins, a stack of rose-gold rings, diamonds and two sports cars. Symmetrical and centred on a clean white ground, with empty space on both sides of her head and shoulders and even studio light.
qualityNote: A photo rather than a flat scan: clean up to about 1600 px, fine detail looks smoothed in the 2400 zoom view. Watch brand names are readable.

alt: The Art of Art, collage: a blue cloudy sky with cut-out words This is Art, TAKE a harder look HONEY, a butterfly and a quill.
description: A bright blue sky full of white clouds fills the sheet, with cut-out magazine words stacked in the centre. A red-and-black butterfly sits on a yellow flower at lower left, a black quill pen points in from the right, and along the bottom are dry hills, a stepped sandstone rock and a dark teal reclining form; a stack of white book edges and a strip of blue-gridded board with a blade are torn in across the top right. Open sky around the words, at top left and mid right, leaves room; even daylight.

alt: Zenda Beach, collage: a giant woman in a yellow coat strides along the horizon above a crowded beach; blue shorts fill the foreground.
description: A giant cut-out woman in a yellow coat and lace-up sandals strides along the horizon at top left, above a busy beach of small sunbathers, a striped parasol and shallow blue water. The bottom third is a huge close-up of a person from behind in blue satin shorts, patched with torn pieces of blue fabric, with a flat-lay of blue toys and clothes down the right edge. Bright hazy seaside light; the open space is the pale sky at top right and the sand through the middle.
qualityNote: Sharp scan, fine to 2400. The top half alone crops to a clean wide beach scene.
